§3§lPurpose and quest§r
The Network Info Panel displays wireless EU data and real-time changes and history curves for ME items and fluids. This quest requires crafting §11§r panel. EU history is shared by the placing player's UUID; AE monitoring data is recorded separately for each panel position.

§3§lPreparation and use§r
Right-click with an empty hand to open configuration. ME monitoring requires a connection to the ME network. Right-click with an item or a recognized filled fluid container to bind a chart target or add or remove live monitoring entries, depending on the active tab. Keep the panel chunk loaded.

§3§lHistory recording§r
History offers §18§r time windows: §15 minutes, 1 hour, 8 hours, 24 hours, 7 days, 1 month, 3 months and 1 year§r. Each window retains its own §161§r FIFO data points. Several curve styles are available, with Fritsch–Carlson splines as the default.

§3§lThree display modes§r
EU Trend shows grid energy and changes. AE Trend charts one bound item or fluid with a blue stock axis and an orange change-rate axis. AE Inventory lists multiple targets with icons, stock, instantaneous changes and §1300-second§r average changes; it supports scrolling, grid layout, font size, bold text and icon size. Choose the mode and monitoring targets on the physical panel.

§3§lTake the screen with you§r
Bind the physical panel by right-clicking it with the Portable Wireless Network Monitor. H or Shift-right-click your own monitor opens the full remote screen; Manage HUD entries selects a simplified persistent display. The monitor uses the actual panel as its source, so its bindings do not replace the panel's ME connection or chunk-loading requirements. EU flat/rising/falling color settings also apply in the portable viewer and HUD mini charts.
